target: Q01: no finite zero-boundary left start keeps column-1 black at every even tick
mechanism: A width-uniform Boolean Nullstellensatz certificate, after exactly solving the in-cone triangular pin constraints. This is an algebraic reader, not a statistical predictor.
coordinates: Fix leftmost black at depthW. Free start bits at nonpivot depths parameterize every survivor of the in-cone even pins. Each remaining pin violation is an exact Boolean function f_i of those free bits.
certificate: Seek 1=sum_i p_i f_i in the Boolean function algebra overF2, restricting multiplier p_i to degree at mostd. Extract the actual selected monomial-times-pin terms, then inspect for a reusable induction.
positive_scope: A finite certificate is not a new period exclusion. No catalog PR for another width. Only a genuinely uniform construction or new implication would be a publishable target.
failure: If the required multiplier degree grows or extracted identities have no stable structure, do not claim a bounded-degree or width-uniform theorem. A timeout is partial, not unsatisfiability.
verification: Independent evaluation of the extracted identity on every free-bit assignment; compare full initial-state enumeration on the smallest widths. A prospective uniform theorem must be proved against official zrow/FinSupp, not this enumeration.
